q1.sampleAnswer: My name’s Li Ming. I’m thirteen years old. I live in Hangzhou, in the east of China. I live with my parents and my grandmother. I use my mobile phone every day, mostly to chat with my friends and to listen to music, but I don’t use it during lessons. My favourite time of day is the evening, because I can relax with my family after school. In the future I’d like to travel around the world, because I want to see different cultures. I like listening to pop music because it makes me happy. I don’t really enjoy shopping – it takes too long and it’s often crowded. In the future I’d like to study biology, because I’m interested in animals. On TV I like watching nature programmes, because I learn a lot from them. I like reading adventure stories, because they’re exciting.

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答不只回答“是/不是”或一个词，而是给出具体信息并说明理由（because…），用一般现在时谈习惯，用 I’d like to… 谈将来的愿望，每个问题说 1–3 句。

q2.sampleAnswer: In this photo I can see a family in a forest. I think they are on holiday or on a day trip. In the middle there’s a man and a woman – maybe the parents. They’re carrying backpacks and they’re looking at a map, so perhaps they’re trying to find the way. On the right there’s a boy in a striped top. He’s standing next to his bike and he’s smiling, so he looks happy. On the left there’s a younger child on a small bike. The path is wide and there are lots of tall trees on both sides. It looks like a cool, quiet day. I think they’re having a nice time together outdoors.

q2.explanationZh: 好的回答按顺序描述照片：人物（是谁、穿什么、在做什么）、地点、其他细节；用现在进行时，遇到不确定的地方用 I think / maybe / It looks like… 猜测，持续说满约一分钟。

q3.sampleAnswer: Yes, sunglasses are useful, because the weather is often sunny in summer. But she might lose them. The earrings are really pretty, but you’re right – she probably won’t wear them every day, so she won’t think about the holiday very often. I agree about the chocolates. They’re delicious, but after a few days there’s nothing left to remember the holiday. Yes, I like the watch a lot. She can look at it many times a day and she’ll remember the sea every time she sees the whale. The teddy bear is cute, but she can’t really use it – she can only look at it. The surfboard is small, so maybe she could put her keys on it. In my opinion, the watch is the best, because she can use it every day. Yes, let’s choose the watch. We agree!

q3.explanationZh: 好的回答能回应搭档的每一个观点（同意/不同意并说明理由），把每个纪念品和“每次使用都能想起假期”这一要求联系起来，用 I think / In my opinion / What about…? / Shall we…? 推动讨论，最后与搭档一起选出最好的纪念品。

q4.sampleAnswer: Yes, I have. Last year I brought a small model of a boat home from Qingdao. It’s on my desk now. The last time I went to the beach was in August. The weather was hot and sunny, so it was perfect. I’d love to live by the sea, because I could swim every day and the air is fresh. But it can be very windy in winter. I think it’s very important for everybody to learn to swim, because it can keep you safe if you fall into the water. I don’t think the beach is always the best place for a holiday. It’s great in summer, but I also like visiting cities and mountains, because there are more things to do.

q4.explanationZh: 好的回答对每个问题都表明观点并给出理由或例子，用一般过去时谈过去的经历（brought, went, was），用 I’d like / I think / because 表达看法，还可以从正反两方面谈。
